setupGuide.comment: Setup-guide navigation row label + sub-page title.

setupGuideDescription.comment: Setup-guide intro paragraph: third-party keyboards must be enabled manually.

values.hanji: 手機仔系統規定第三方齒盤愛手動啟用才會當使用，請照下跤 ê 說明完成設定。
values.tailo: tshiú-ki-á hē-thóng kui-tīng tē-sann hong khí-puânn ài tshiú-tōng khé-iōng tsiah ē-tàng sú-iōng, tshiánn tsiàu ē-kha ê suat-bîng uân-sîng siat-tīng.
values.poj: chhiú-ki-á hē-thóng kui-tēng tē-saⁿ hong khí-pôaⁿ ài chhiú-tōng khé-iōng chiah ē-tàng sú-iōng, chhiáⁿ chiàu ē-kha ê soat-bêng oân-sêng siat-tēng.
values.en: Your phone requires third-party keyboards to be enabled manually. Follow the steps below to finish setup.
values.ja: スマートフォンの仕様上、サードパーティ製キーボードは手動で有効にする必要があります。下記の手順に従って設定を完了してください。

setupInfoMessage.comment: Setup-guide note explaining that 'Allow Full Access' permits app/keyboard data sharing and stating the network privacy policy.

values.hanji: 「允准完整取用」予齒盤會當佮 App 共用設定佮使用資料。台語齒盤袂共你拍 ê 內容送去網路。
values.tailo: "ún-tsún uân-tsíng tshú-iōng" hōo khí-puânn ē-tàng kah App kiōng-iōng siat-tīng kah sú-iōng tsu-liāu. tâi-gí khí-puânn buē kā lí phah ê luē-iông sàng khì bāng-lōo.
values.poj: "ún-chún oân-chéng chhú-iōng" hō͘ khí-pôaⁿ ē-tàng kah App kiōng-iōng siat-tēng kah sú-iōng chu-liāu. tâi-gí khí-pôaⁿ bōe kā lí phah ê lōe-iông sàng khì bāng-lō͘.
values.en: "Allow Full Access" lets the keyboard share settings and usage data with the app. Taigi Keyboard does not send what you type over the network.
values.ja: 「フルアクセスを許可」すると、キーボードとアプリで設定や利用データを共有できます。台語キーボードは入力内容をネットワークへ送信しません。

setupBrandWarning.comment: Setup-guide note: steps may differ slightly across phone brands.

values.hanji: 無仝牌子 ê 手機仔，設定 ê 方式可能會淡薄仔無仝款，毋過方式應該攏差不多。
values.tailo: bô kâng pâi-tsú ê tshiú-ki-á, siat-tīng ê hong-sik khó-lîng huē tām-po̍h-á bô-kāng-khuán, m̄-koh hong-sik ìng-kai láng tsha-put-to.
values.poj: bô kâng pâi-chú ê chhiú-ki-á, siat-tēng ê hong-sek khó-lêng hōe tām-po̍h-á bô-kāng-khoán, m̄-koh hong-sek èng-kai láng chha-put-to.
values.en: Steps may differ slightly between phone brands, but the overall process is much the same.
values.ja: スマートフォンのメーカーによって設定方法が少し異なる場合がありますが、大まかな流れはほぼ同じです。

setupGuideCompletedMessage.comment: Setup-guide full-screen closing paragraph: restart the app and switch via the globe key.

values.hanji: 完成了後，重開你目前使用 ê App，予 App 重新載入新 ê 齒盤清單。紲落來，佇會當拍字 ê 所在，揤牢地球圖示切去台語齒盤
values.tailo: uân-sîng liáu-āu, tîng-khui lí ba̍k-tsîng sú-iōng ê App, hōo App tîng-sin tsài-ji̍p sin ê khí-puânn tshing-tuann. suà--lo̍h-lâi, tī ē-tàng phah-jī ê sóo-tsāi, tshi̍h tiâu tuē-kiû tôo-sī tshiat khì tâi-gí khí-puânn
values.poj: oân-sêng liáu-āu, têng-khui lí ba̍k-chêng sú-iōng ê App, hō͘ App tîng-sin chài-ji̍p sin ê khí-pôaⁿ chheng-toaⁿ. sòa--lo̍h-lâi, tī ē-tàng phah-jī ê só͘-chāi, chhi̍h tiâu tōe-kiû tô͘-sī chhiat khì tâi-gí khí-pôaⁿ
values.en: Once done, restart the app you are using so it reloads the keyboard list. Then, wherever you can type, press and hold the globe icon to switch to Taigi Keyboard.
values.ja: 完了したら、使用中のアプリを再起動してキーボード一覧を読み込み直してください。その後、文字を入力できる場所で地球儀アイコンを長押しして、台湾語キーボードに切り替えます。

setupGuideGoToSettings.comment: Setup-guide button: open the system input-method settings page.

setupGuideStep2AddKeyboard.comment: Setup-guide step 2 title: tap 'Add keyboard' and 'Allow Full Access'.

values.ja: 「キーボードを追加」「フルアクセスを許可」をタップ

freePromise.comment: About-developer page body: the maintainer's promise that the keyboard stays free.

values.hanji: 台語齒盤會一直免費，嘛袂設付費功能。我向望想欲學台語、寫台語 ê 人攏會當無負擔使用。
values.tailo: tâi-gí khí-puânn ē it-ti̍t bián-huì, mā buē siat hù-huì kong-lîng. guá ǹg-bāng siūnn-beh ha̍k tâi-gí, siá tâi-gí ê lâng lóng ē-tàng bô hū-tam sú-iōng.
values.poj: tâi-gí khí-pôaⁿ ē it-ti̍t bián-hùi, mā bōe siat hù-hùi kong-lêng. góa ǹg-bāng siūⁿ-beh ha̍k tâi-gí, siá tâi-gí ê lâng lóng ē-tàng bô hū-tam sú-iōng.
values.en: Taigi Keyboard will remain free and will not add paid features. I want everyone who wishes to learn or write Taiwanese to be able to use it without cost.
values.ja: 台語キーボードは今後も無料で、有料機能を設けません。台湾語を学びたい、書きたい人が費用を気にせず使えることを願っています。
